verdict.rationale: The EDD's file-and-pay page lists Federal/State Employment Taxes (FSET) and Electronic Funds Transfer via a State Data Collector and ACH Credit as filing and payment methods, which suggests machine-to-machine rails, but the evidence only names them. The documented enrollment covers human e-Services logins and third-party representative portal access, not system accounts. No OpenAPI or other machine-readable spec was found, and the transactional portal returned 403 to an automated agent. missing for 10: description of the FSET/EFT transmitter or batch-provider programs, a published enrollment path for software or system accounts, technical specs or file formats, independent corroboration.
